# Specs Generation — Template Index

Section templates for each issue type are maintained in their own skill files. This file is a routing index only.

| Issue Type | Template file |
|------------|---------------|
| Story / Task / Bug / Regression Bug | `specs-generation-story/SKILL.md` |
| Epic | `specs-generation-epic/SKILL.md` |
| Spike | `specs-generation-spike/SKILL.md` |

All specs-writer agents must load the issue-type-specific skill file above rather than this index.
